The best CRM consultants in 2026 split into three groups: independent advisors who help you pick a CRM, platform specialists who implement one CRM very well, and automation-first teams who set up the CRM and build the workflows around it. Hiring the wrong type is the most common mistake. A HubSpot specialist will not tell you Dynamics is the better fit, and a selection advisor will not build your lead routing.

This guide compares 9 CRM consulting firms across HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho and Microsoft Dynamics, with published prices where they exist, what each firm actually does, and a framework to pick the right CRM agency for your team.

Disclosure: ManasFlow wrote this guide and ranks itself first. We put ourselves at #1 because we implement the CRM and build the automation on top of it (enrichment, routing, outbound and AI agents) in one team, across several CRMs. If you need a vendor-neutral CRM selection, a top-tier HubSpot or Salesforce partner, or a Dynamics 365 firm, one of the other consultants below fits better, and we say which.
Best CRM consultants: a brief overview
ManasFlow: Best overall for automation-first teams: CRM implementation plus enrichment, lead routing, outbound integrations and AI agents, on HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, Pipedrive or Attio.
CRM Switch: Best for vendor-neutral CRM selection: independent advisors who take no software commissions.
Aptitude 8: Best for complex HubSpot builds with heavy integration work.
Hypha HubSpot Development: Best for SMBs that want HubSpot CRM, website and marketing from one shop.
RevPartners: Best for HubSpot teams that want ongoing RevOps on a monthly retainer.
Coastal: Best for mid-market and enterprise Salesforce programs.
Vantage Point: Best for financial services firms on Salesforce or HubSpot.
Zenatta: Best for companies standardizing on Zoho One.
Velosio: Best for Microsoft-stack companies running Dynamics 365.
Lowest published starting price, in USD

Source: each firm's own pricing or FAQ page, checked 2026-10-21. The other five firms, ManasFlow included, quote per project, so they are not plotted. Starting prices cover different scopes and are not a like-for-like comparison.
1. ManasFlow, best overall CRM consultant for automation-first teams

ManasFlow is an AI automation agency that implements your CRM and then builds what makes it useful day to day: lead capture, enrichment, routing, deduplication, outbound sequences and AI agents that update records through the CRM's API. We work across HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, Pipedrive and Attio, so the advice on which CRM to use is not tied to one vendor's partner program.

We run the same kind of system for our own pipeline (Attio as the CRM, with n8n, Instantly, HeyReach and Unipile around it), which is why our CRM projects usually include the outbound and data plumbing that other consultants hand to a second vendor. Delivery runs in English, French and Arabic.
Key features
CRM implementation and migration, scoped on a free call first (CRM implementation services)
Weekly CRM hygiene automation: dedupe, stalled-deal flags, lead routing and a Slack digest
Enrichment and outbound wired into the CRM (Clay, Instantly, HeyReach)
AI agents for pre-call research, lead scoring and CRM updates, with every write logged
Platform pages for HubSpot, Salesforce and Zoho work
Best for
B2B teams whose leads come from outbound and need one clean record per account
Companies moving between CRMs that want the automations rebuilt, not dropped
Teams in Europe and MENA that want a bilingual or trilingual partner
Pricing
Custom quote after a discovery call, scoped per workflow

Implementation and automation in one project, so the CRM is useful on day one

Real outbound and RevOps experience from running our own pipeline
Cons

2. CRM Switch, best for vendor-neutral CRM selection

CRM Switch is an independent advisory firm founded in 2010 by Steve Chipman and Daryn Reif and based in the San Francisco Bay Area. Its site states that it is 100% independent and does not sell CRM software or take commissions tied to platforms.

The firm runs strategy and selection, project management, change management and CRM coaching, mainly for manufacturing, distribution, software and B2B services companies. Its FAQ says most projects run 8 to 12 weeks, and its about page says the firm does not perform implementations.
Key features
CRM requirements and vendor selection
Project and change management during rollout
CRM coaching for internal admins
Best for
Buyers who have not picked a CRM yet
Companies replacing a CRM after a failed rollout
Pricing
Engagements typically start around $15,000 and range to $25,000 or more
Pros
No vendor incentives behind the recommendation
Fifteen-plus years focused on CRM decisions
Cons
Selection and planning are the core offer, not hands-on build work
Fees are high for very small teams
3. Aptitude 8, best for complex HubSpot builds

Aptitude 8 calls itself a technical consulting firm rather than an agency. It is an Elite HubSpot Solutions partner with accreditations in CRM implementation, custom integration and advanced CMS, and it claims the largest technical consulting team of any HubSpot partner, all in-house and US-based.
The work covers implementation, migration (including Salesforce to HubSpot), custom integrations with Dynamics, NetSuite and QuickBooks, custom development and RevOps as a service.
Key features
HubSpot CRM architecture and deployment
Custom integrations with ERP and finance systems
Salesforce to HubSpot migrations
RevOps and MarOps as a service
Best for
Mid-market and enterprise companies running HubSpot as the center of the stack
Projects with ERP or custom data integrations
Pricing
Custom quote
Pros
Elite HubSpot tier with integration accreditations
Strong engineering depth
Cons
HubSpot only
More firm than a simple SMB setup needs
4. Hypha HubSpot Development, best for HubSpot plus web and marketing

Hypha is a New York-based HubSpot Diamond Solutions partner with accreditations in custom integration, onboarding and solutions architecture design. It handles HubSpot onboarding, configuration and integrations, plus CMS and web development, inbound content, outbound prospecting and migrations from Salesforce and Act!.
Its pricing page is clear: HubSpot onboarding runs $1,000 to $3,750 per month for one to three months, and marketing retainers run $5,000 to $7,500 per month.
Key features
HubSpot onboarding and integrations
HubSpot CMS websites
Inbound and outbound marketing services
Best for
SMBs that want CRM, website and marketing from one vendor
Teams moving from Act! or Salesforce to HubSpot
Pricing
Onboarding $1,000 to $3,750 per month for one to three months
Marketing retainers $5,000 to $7,500 per month
Pros
Published, affordable onboarding pricing
One shop for CRM and website
Cons
HubSpot only
Leans toward marketing and web more than deep RevOps
5. RevPartners, best for ongoing HubSpot RevOps

RevPartners describes itself as RevOps and GTM engineering for businesses on HubSpot and Clay. It holds HubSpot Elite Solutions partner and Clay Elite Studio status and reports 1,000+ CRM and RevOps deployments. It migrates teams from Salesforce, Marketo, Pipedrive, Dynamics and Zendesk.

Pricing is published in detail: HubSpot Sales Hub implementations from $1,500, Marketing Hub from $3,000, and RevOps as a Service from $9,850 to $27,000 per month on a 6-month term plus a $5,000 onboarding fee.
Key features
HubSpot implementations and migrations
RevOps as a Service retainers
Clay builds connected to HubSpot
Best for
HubSpot companies that want a RevOps team on retainer
Teams migrating into HubSpot from another CRM
Pricing
HubSpot Sales Hub implementation from $1,500
RevOps as a Service from $9,850 per month, 6-month term
Pros
Transparent, tiered pricing
HubSpot and Clay in one firm
Cons
HubSpot only, so not for Salesforce shops
Retainers start near $10,000 per month with a 6-month minimum
6. Coastal, best for mid-market and enterprise Salesforce

Coastal is a Salesforce consultancy that has been a top-tier Salesforce partner since 2012 and is now backed by Tata Consultancy Services. It covers strategy, implementation, integration, data modernization, Agentforce, analytics and change management across Sales, Service, Marketing, Commerce, Revenue and Data Cloud, plus MuleSoft, Tableau and Slack.
Key features
Multi-cloud Salesforce implementations
Agentforce and Data Cloud projects
MuleSoft and Tableau integration
Best for
Mid-market and enterprise companies on Salesforce
Multi-cloud programs that need a large bench
Pricing
Custom quote
Pros
Long top-tier Salesforce track record
Depth across the full Salesforce product line
Cons
Salesforce only
Likely oversized for small teams
For a deeper comparison of Salesforce firms, see our guide to the best Salesforce consulting firms.
7. Vantage Point, best for financial services

Vantage Point, founded in 2018 and based in Dallas with a practice in Sofia, Bulgaria, focuses on CRM implementation, integration and managed services for wealth managers, banks, insurers and lenders. It works on Salesforce, including Financial Services Cloud, and HubSpot, and migrates firms off Redtail and Wealthbox.
It is one of the few firms with fixed-scope packages on its site.
Key features
Salesforce Financial Services Cloud
HubSpot for advisory and lending firms
Migrations from wealth management CRMs
Best for
Wealth managers, banks, insurers and lenders
Regulated firms that need audit trails in the CRM
Pricing
HubSpot portal audit $3,500
HubSpot foundation packages $7,500
Salesforce Sales Cloud foundation from $10,000
Financial Services Cloud foundation from $22,000
Pros
Published fixed-scope packages
Industry focus on financial services
Cons
Narrow industry focus
Two CRMs only
CRM implementation
Need a CRM your team actually uses?
We implement and migrate HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, Pipedrive and Attio, then automate the work around them. Free 30-minute call.
8. Zenatta, best for Zoho One

Zenatta is a Zoho Premium partner, Zoho Partner of the Year Americas in 2024 and 2025, and Global Partner of the Year 2025. Its 38 specialists work from Las Vegas, Calgary and Belo Horizonte, covering Zoho CRM, Creator, Books, Analytics and Desk.
Zenatta's FAQ says most mid-market Zoho implementations run $15,000 to $60,000. Our Zoho consultants comparison covers eight more Zoho firms if you are set on Zoho.
Key features
Zoho One rollouts across departments
Zoho Creator custom apps
Zoho Books finance setup
Best for
SMBs and mid-market companies consolidating on Zoho One
Pricing
Sprint-based hourly retainer; mid-market projects typically $15,000 to $60,000
Pros
Highest Zoho partner tier and repeated awards
CRM and finance in one firm
Cons
Zoho only
